notes.title: "Run away from me. Alexandra" DEMO is now available for play!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, the demo of the game "Run away from me. Alexandra" is now available on Steam. Thank you all for your support! We have reached this point only thanks to you all! There is more to come!

Play the demo version, leave your opinion, we are very interested in reading all your comments. The release version, of course, will be more interactive and filled with screamers, achievements and other delights that we can offer.

Through the demo, you will get acquainted with the game interface and its capabilities. Thank you for being with us!
